description: Search crypto and supported TradFi assets by name or ticker. Returns matching assets with asset class, market cap, and nullable price, day return, FDV, ATH, and estimated ATH market cap fields.
name: search_market_cap

athMarketCap.description: An estimate, not the market cap recorded at the all-time high: ATH price x the current circulating supply (current market cap / current price). Supply changes over time, so the figure can differ from the market cap that actually existed at the ATH. Null when there is no ATH price.

dayReturn.description: The day's price return as a fraction, 0.0041 = +0.41%: for crypto over the last 24 hours; for stocks, ETFs, indices and commodity proxies the last trading session against the prior close (a Monday pre-market reading is Friday's session), not a rolling 24 hours.

meta.description: Which route answered, what the API said about the data's freshness, and whether the client cut the answer to fit the agent's context window.

route.description: Always `v1`: every call reads the keyed /v1 route.

truncated.description: True when the answer is cut short: by the API's row budget, or by the client (`truncated_fields`).

truncated_fields.description: The arrays and strings the client cut, by JSON path in `data`: `total` items received, `showing` kept, `kept: latest` when an oldest-first series kept its newest items.

warnings.description: What the API or the client could not do, in words. State them with the answer.

pagination.description: Present when the answer is one page: pass `cursor` back to read the next one.

title: Market cap search
